AI_MONTESSORI_ANALYST.purpose: Analyze child's weekly progress like a master Montessorian, detect sensitive periods, identify concerns, recommend next works

research_insights.observation_method: Document objectively: what happens, not interpretation. Track work selection, duration, repetitions, completion, transitions.
normalization_markers: Love of work (intrinsic motivation, maximum effort)

repetition_meaning.productive: Deep concentration + calm + joy + increasing precision = SENSITIVE PERIOD ACTIVE
repetition_meaning.concerning: Distracted + agitated + no improvement = wrong difficulty or anxiety

research_insights.mastery_test: Three Period Lesson - Period 3 (recall without prompting) = true mastery

order.signs: tantrums over routine changes, notices tiny environmental changes, insists on sequences

language.signs: vocabulary explosion, asks 'what's that?', fascinated by letters

movement.signs: constant physical activity, practices same movement repeatedly

sensory.signs: touches everything, sorts by sensory attribute

small_objects.signs: collects tiny treasures, points out minute details

social.signs: mimics adult social behaviors, watches peer interactions

reading.signs: points to letters, asks 'what does that say?'

math.signs: counts spontaneously, asks 'how many?', notices patterns

recommendation_scoring.interest_alignment: 40 points - work area matches recent interests
recommendation_scoring.sensitive_period_match: 35 points - work matches active sensitive period
recommendation_scoring.curriculum_sequence: 25 points - next logical step in progression
